title: Export Drawing to PDF, DXF/DWG and STEP
keywords: solidworks macro save pdf dxf step, solidworks export drawing pdf dxf step macro
summary: Exports the active drawing to PDF, DXF and DWG, then exports the first referenced model to STEP with filename parts from custom properties.
inputs: Optional PartNo, Revision and Description custom properties
filenameRules: {PartNo}_{Revision}_{Description}; falls back to the drawing filename when properties are missing.
limitations: Only the active drawing is processed.
The STEP file is exported from the first referenced model found in the drawing.
DXF/DWG output depends on SOLIDWORKS drawing export settings.

title: Batch Export Drawings to PDF
keywords: solidworks batch export drawings to pdf macro, solidworks save drawing as pdf macro
summary: Selects a folder, opens every .SLDDRW file in it, rebuilds the drawing and saves a PDF into a PDF subfolder.
filenameRules: Uses the drawing filename and writes into a PDF subfolder.
limitations: Processes one folder level.
Drawings with missing references may require user repair before export.

title: Sheet-Metal Flat Pattern DXF Batch Export
keywords: solidworks sheet metal dxf export macro, solidworks flat pattern dxf batch export
summary: Traverses the active assembly or part and exports sheet-metal flat patterns as DXF files using model properties where available.
limitations: Requires parts to contain valid flat-pattern features.
Complex multi-body sheet-metal parts may need shop-specific review.
DXF options follow the installed SOLIDWORKS defaults.

title: Export All Configurations to STEP
keywords: solidworks export configurations to step macro
summary: Exports every configuration of the active part or assembly to a separate STEP file.
limitations: Suppressed or invalid configurations may fail export.
Large assemblies can take time to rebuild between configurations.

title: Export All Configurations to STL
keywords: solidworks export configurations to stl macro
summary: Exports each configuration of the active part or assembly as an STL file.
limitations: Uses the current SOLIDWORKS STL export options.
Hidden bodies and suppressed features follow the active configuration state.

title: Multi-Format Active Document Exporter
keywords: solidworks export multiple formats macro
summary: Exports the active document into the formats that make sense for its document type.
filenameRules: Uses the active document filename and creates an Exports subfolder.
limitations: Drawing exports PDF/DXF/DWG; part and assembly exports STEP/STL.
Format settings come from the current SOLIDWORKS options.

title: BOM and Table Export to CSV or Excel
keywords: solidworks bom export excel macro, solidworks table to csv macro
summary: Finds BOM or general tables in the active drawing or assembly and exports their visible cells to CSV, with optional Excel automation.
inputs: Open drawing or assembly containing BOM/table annotations
limitations: Exports visible table text, not resolved ERP data.
Excel export requires Microsoft Excel to be installed.

title: Batch Custom Property Reader/Writer from CSV
keywords: solidworks custom properties macro, solidworks batch edit custom properties
summary: Reads a CSV file containing file paths, configuration names and property values, then updates SOLIDWORKS custom properties.
inputs: CSV with FilePath, Configuration, PropertyName, Value columns
filenameRules: Does not export files; writes custom properties to the listed documents.
limitations: Always test on copied files first.
CSV parsing supports quoted fields but should be kept simple for production use.

title: Export PDF/DXF/STEP with Filename from Custom Properties
keywords: solidworks save as pdf with revision macro, solidworks filename from custom property macro
summary: Builds export filenames from PartNo, Revision and Description custom properties instead of raw SOLIDWORKS filenames.
inputs: Optional PartNo, Revision and Description custom properties
limitations: Part and assembly documents export STEP only.
Drawing documents export PDF and DXF.

title: Open Associated Drawing
keywords: solidworks open associated drawing macro
summary: Opens the likely drawing for the active model or selected assembly component by checking same-folder and configured search paths.
filenameRules: Looks for matching .SLDDRW files using the model base filename.
limitations: Cannot guarantee matches when drawings use unrelated names.
Additional search folders can be added in the macro constants.

title: Open Selected Component
keywords: solidworks open selected component macro
summary: Opens the selected assembly component in its own SOLIDWORKS window.
inputs: Active assembly with one selected component
limitations: Requires a component selection, not just a face or edge selection.

title: Open Parent Assembly Candidate
keywords: solidworks open parent assembly macro, solidworks where used search
summary: Searches a selected folder for assemblies that reference the active model and opens the first candidate.
limitations: Folder scanning can be slow on very large workspaces.
For indexed where-used across a workspace, use Solidise.

title: Pack and Go with Prefix/Suffix or Custom-Property Naming
keywords: solidworks pack and go custom property macro
summary: Runs Pack and Go into a selected folder and applies prefix/suffix naming, with a hook for custom-property based names.
filenameRules: Uses user prefix/suffix around the original filename in v1.
limitations: Custom-property naming is conservative to avoid broken references.
Always inspect the Pack and Go result before releasing.

title: Collect Referenced Release Deliverables
keywords: solidworks collect referenced drawings pdf dxf macro
summary: Copies already-generated deliverables for referenced files into one release folder.
filenameRules: Collects files with matching base filenames and PDF/DXF/DWG/STEP extensions.
limitations: Does not generate missing deliverables.
Searches same folders as referenced models by default.

title: Rebuild Drawings Before PDF Export
keywords: solidworks rebuild drawings before pdf export macro
summary: Batch opens drawings from a selected folder, rebuilds them and exports fresh PDFs.
filenameRules: Exports to RebuiltPDF subfolder using drawing filenames.
limitations: May expose missing references or rebuild errors that need manual repair.

title: Export Each Drawing Sheet as a Separate PDF
keywords: solidworks export drawing sheets separate pdf macro
summary: Exports every sheet in the active drawing to its own PDF file.
limitations: Uses the active drawing's sheet export behavior.
Very long sheet names are sanitized for Windows filenames.

title: Hide or Show Sketches, Planes, Origins and Axes
keywords: solidworks hide planes sketches macro
summary: Toggles common reference geometry visibility before screenshots, exports or reviews.
limitations: Visibility behavior follows SOLIDWORKS document/view state.

title: Rename Configurations from a Custom Property
keywords: solidworks rename configurations custom property macro
summary: Renames configurations using a chosen custom property, with duplicate-safe suffixes.
inputs: Property name to read from each configuration
limitations: Renaming configurations can affect downstream references; test on copies first.

title: Rename Drawing Sheets and Views from Model Properties
keywords: solidworks rename drawing sheets macro
summary: Renames drawing sheets and views from referenced model properties such as PartNo and Description.
limitations: Views without referenced models keep their current names.
Duplicate sheet names receive suffixes.

title: Title Block Sync from Model Custom Properties
keywords: solidworks title block custom properties macro
summary: Copies key custom properties from the first referenced model into the drawing so title blocks can resolve consistently.
inputs: Referenced model with PartNo, Revision, Description and Material properties
limitations: Copies a conservative property list in v1.
Title block notes must already be linked to drawing custom properties.

title: BOM Checker for Missing Properties
keywords: solidworks bom custom property checker macro
summary: Scans BOM rows for missing part number, description, material and revision values, then writes a CSV report.
inputs: Open drawing or assembly with BOM table
limitations: Checks visible BOM table text.
For workspace-wide BOM visibility and where-used search, use Solidise.
